name: opencode-shim
description: Self-contained Hankweave shim package for the OpenCode CLI

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('./dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('./dist',{recursive:true});" && bun build ./src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outfile ./dist/index.js
